about.title: Where vital breath meets code
about.p1: VayuLab is born at the intersection of ancient wisdom and digital innovation. Inspired by the concept of <0>Vayu</0> — the vital breath that connects the inner to the outer — we develop projects that translate complex concepts of philosophy and science into practical experiences.
about.p2: We are not just developers; we are experience architects seeking to elevate human consciousness through technology.

meditary.title: Meditary
meditary.description: Your deep meditation journal. Meditary is not just a timer; it is a self-inquiry tool designed to map your inner journey.
meditary.feature1_desc: Identify concentration patterns and mental states.
